name: Manganic-Cwm
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near orbital debris ring.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built buried megastructure left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
